messages.content: I want the Columbus and Cincinnati pieces checked all the way through now. Give me the actual hotel totals, and verify that the one-way car quote really includes the drop fee. The Wednesday timing matters more than saving twenty or thirty dollars.

I have two practical hotel choices in each city and two rental quotes to compare. Before I total the combinations, are you planning to collect the car at CMH Monday night after the 7:33 p.m. arrival, or wait until Tuesday morning?
Monday night. I do not want to spend Tuesday morning going back to the airport before the 9:00 review near Easton.

That makes the Easton hotels the useful Columbus options. Aloft Columbus Easton is $189 for Monday, plus $32.13 tax, with self-parking included: $221.13 total. Hilton Columbus at Easton is $214, plus $36.38 tax and $12 parking: $262.38 total. Both are about 10 minutes from the Tuesday review; Aloft is the lower complete cost by $41.25.
Use the Aloft in the comparison unless the cancellation terms are bad. What are the Cincinnati numbers?

Aloft allows cancellation without charge until 6:00 p.m. local time on Sunday, July 20. In Cincinnati, Courtyard Cincinnati Midtown/Rookwood is $176, plus $30.80 tax and $12 parking, for $218.80. It is roughly 5-10 minutes from the Oakley inspection. The lower quote is Holiday Inn Cincinnati-Riverfront in Covington at $149, plus $25.33 tax and $12 parking, for $186.33. That saves $32.47, but Wednesday morning traffic to Oakley is typically 20-35 minutes instead of under 10.
And after the inspection? I have to be at CVG in time for the 7:35 flight, not just close to Oakley at 3:00.

From Oakley to CVG, allow about 30-45 minutes in normal Wednesday afternoon traffic and up to 55 minutes if congestion builds. Leaving the inspection at 3:00 should put you at the rental return around 3:45-3:55 in the slower case, more than three hours before departure. The Courtyard avoids an extra cross-city leg before the appointment; the Covington hotel produces a longer Wednesday route overall but does not change the final Oakley-to-airport segment.
Fine. Now the car. The cheaper result last time looked like it was missing something.

It was. The National display showed $198.47 in time-and-mileage charges and taxes, but its detailed terms list a $75 intercity drop charge separately. The complete National total is therefore $273.47. Unlimited mileage is included; fuel, tolls, and optional coverage are not.
What is the other one, and did you verify the fee there instead of assuming it is included?

Enterprise is $248.61 total. The itemization is $142.00 base rate, $65.00 one-way charge, and $41.61 in taxes and facility fees. The reservation terms explicitly show the return location as CVG, so there is no additional drop charge due at return unless the location is changed. Unlimited mileage is included; fuel, tolls, and optional protection remain extra.
Check the counter hours against the flights. I land at 7:33 Monday and I do not want a closed desk. I also need to know whether a return around 4:00 Wednesday works.

Enterprise at CMH is open until 11:30 p.m. Monday. Allowing 25-40 minutes to deplane and reach the rental center puts pickup around 8:00-8:15 p.m., comfortably within hours. The CVG Enterprise counter is open until midnight Wednesday, and the garage accepts returns throughout operating hours, so a 3:45-4:00 p.m. return works. National is open until midnight at CMH and has 24-hour returns at CVG.
Lay out Tuesday with the Aloft and Enterprise. I want to see whether the drive estimate still leaves a reasonable Cincinnati arrival.

Monday: land at CMH at 7:33 p.m., collect the Enterprise car around 8:00-8:15, and reach Aloft Easton around 8:25-8:40. Tuesday: leave the hotel around 8:35 for the 9:00 review, finish near 11:00, then depart Easton around 11:15. The direct route is I-270 south to I-71 south, about 110 miles. Allow 1 hour 45 minutes to 2 hours 10 minutes, putting you in the Rookwood/Oakley area around 1:00-1:25 p.m. before Tuesday hotel check-in; the Courtyard can hold the luggage until the room is ready.
Compare the two Cincinnati hotels as a complete Wednesday, including checkout, the 1:00 appointment, and the airport. I do not need sightseeing time.

From the Courtyard, you can check out at noon, leave the car and luggage with the hotel if needed, then depart about 12:40 for a 12:50 arrival at Oakley. After the 1:00-3:00 inspection, leaving by 3:10 should reach the CVG rental return around 3:45-4:00; the terminal shuttle and security should put you at the gate roughly 4:30-4:50. From the Covington hotel, I would leave by 12:10-12:20 for Oakley because the eastbound drive can take 25-40 minutes. The post-inspection airport timing is the same, but the day adds roughly 20-30 minutes of driving before the appointment and has less buffer if traffic stalls.
So the cheaper Cincinnati room is not endangering the flight, but it makes the appointment side tighter. Is that accurate?

Yes. Either hotel leaves ample time for the 7:35 p.m. flight because the inspection ends at 3:00. The Courtyard is the cleaner schedule: a short hotel-to-appointment transfer, then one westbound drive to CVG. Covington saves $32.47 but requires crossing toward Oakley before the inspection and then reversing course toward the airport during the afternoon commute.
Use Aloft, the Courtyard, and Enterprise as the chosen combination. Give me the total with the open-jaw airfare, and keep the 5:45 return noted only as the earlier workable flight. Do not book yet.

Chosen without booking: Aloft Columbus Easton Monday at $221.13 total; Courtyard Cincinnati Midtown/Rookwood Tuesday at $218.80 total; and Enterprise CMH-to-CVG from Monday evening through Wednesday afternoon at $248.61, including the $65 one-way fee. With the $402 open-jaw airfare, the complete priced total is $1,090.54, excluding fuel, tolls, and optional rental coverage. Monday pickup and Wednesday return are within counter hours. Tuesday's Easton-to-Cincinnati drive remains 1 hour 45 minutes to 2 hours 10 minutes. On Wednesday, leave the Courtyard about 12:40 for the 1:00 Oakley inspection, depart Oakley by 3:10, and expect the CVG return around 3:45-4:00 for the 7:35 p.m. departure. The 5:45 p.m. CVG flight remains recorded as the earlier workable alternative, but it is not selected. Nothing has been purchased.
